feeds.title: Think Productive Blog
feeds.description: Think Productive is one of the world's leading time management training providers. They help organizations all over the world to increase productivity and wellbeing with practical time management & productivity training.

feeds.title: LifeHack » Productivity
feeds.description: At LifeHack, we have helped millions of readers get to the root of their own life's purpose by taking the complicated and breaking it down into a simple process. The Productivity blog will give you insights and empowerment in the workplace or at home

feeds.title: Financial Times » UK Labour Productivity
feeds.description: The Financial Times is one of the world's leading news organizations, recognized internationally for its authority, integrity, and accuracy. The UK Labour Productivity section on the website will provide you with news, analysis, and comments from the Financial Times.

feeds.title: Mark Manson
feeds.description: Mark Manson's personal development advice is nothing like the ordinary - forget clichéd or unrealistic tips. Mark's goal with his site is to provide a reality-based form of self-help, and he most certainly achieves this goal with his articles.

feeds.title: Productive Blogging
feeds.description: My name is Eb Gargano and I am passionate about bloggers achieving their goals without feeling overwhelmed. Productive Blogging is for bloggers who want to see real results and real money in their pockets, but still have time to spend with their families and enjoy the rest of life.

feeds.title: Clare Evans Blog
feeds.description: Clare Evans the UK's leading Time Management expert shares tips and strategies to improve your Time Management. She has an integrated approach when working with clients that also includes all aspects of your work and life. She is passionate about helping people understand the stress, pressure, and overwhelm they're facing in their day-to-day lives and supporting them to realize there's more to life than work and that things can be different.

feeds.title: Jo Bendle Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jo Bendle. I'm a business coach and mentor, I've spent over 10 years helping women claim more from life and business. Through my courses, workshops, and mentoring programs, I teach business owners the tools and strategies they need to achieve their goals and build the businesses of their dreams.
